The questions we get most often. Always open — no dropdowns. If you want more, our contact team answers same-day. What does RobotLAB actually do? RobotLAB is America's largest commercial robotics integrator. We sell, deploy, train, monitor, and service commercial service robots from 22+ manufacturers — including Pudu, Bear Robotics, Gausium, LG, SoftBank, and Temi. Founded in 2007 in Dallas, we've delivered $120M+ in robots to 5,000+ businesses across all 50 U.S. states and shipped to 100+ countries & states. What industries does RobotLAB serve? 60+ industries with active deployments. The biggest verticals are hotels, restaurants, healthcare, assisted living, warehouses, and K-12 schools. We also deploy in airports, multifamily, gyms, retail, government, manufacturing, car dealerships, and entertainment venues. What capabilities do RobotLAB's robots have? Across our fleet we cover: autonomous cleaning (270M+ sq ft cleaned), commercial delivery (213M+ tasks), cooking, customer service, security patrol, UV-C disinfection, wayfinding, brand ambassador, agricultural drones, plus STEM, VR/AR, coding-and-AI, fabrication-lab, innovation-lab, and AI-lab capabilities for education. How much does a commercial robot from RobotLAB cost? Entry-level robots like Whiz vacuum start at $9,800. Mid-tier delivery robots like BellaBot Pro start at $16,000. Commercial scrubbers like Gausium Scrubber 50 start at $18,900. RaaS subscriptions start at $499/month all-inclusive. What's the typical payback period for a commercial robot? Delivery robots in restaurants: 8–12 months. Cleaning robots in hotels: 9–14 months. Bussing robots: 7–10 months. Warehouse AGVs: 12–18 months. UV-C disinfection in healthcare: 12–18 months plus avoided infection costs. How do I buy, lease, or subscribe to a robot from RobotLAB? Three paths: outright purchase (Net 30 for commercial accounts), equipment lease ($1 buyout, Section 179 eligible, 36–60 month terms), or RaaS — Robots-as-a-Service ($499+/mo all-inclusive, 36-month standard term, convert-to-purchase any time after month 12). Does RobotLAB service the robots after deployment? Yes. 20+ local service centers nationwide. Standard service plan ($199/mo per unit) includes 24/7 support, software updates, parts and labor, loaner if downtime over 48h, quarterly health checks, fleet monitoring, and annual on-site visit. Average fleet uptime 97%. Which robot manufacturers does RobotLAB carry? 22 manufacturers: Pudu (US-exclusive), Bear Robotics, Gausium, LG Business Solutions, SoftBank (Pepper/NAO/Whiz — US-exclusive), Temi, Keenon, CenoBots, Cleanfix, UBTech, Cyngn, Vision Aerial, AgileX, Dobot, Unitree, Niryo, Blueye, Dremel, Botinkit, Firia Labs, R-Zero/UVD. How do I get started with RobotLAB? Use the finder at the top of robotlab.com — tell us your industry, region, and goal, and we'll shortlist robots that fit. Or request a free on-site demo — same-day response, walkthrough within 5 business days. Or call 1-87-RobotLAB Mon–Fri 8a–6p CT. Didn't find your answer? Same-day response by email or phone.
